About the MRC Partnership event

MRC Partnership is a Emergency Preparedness event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA MRC Partnership team event, following the 2026–27 guidelines: a year-long partnership with a local Medical Reserve Corps unit (July 1–May 15), a pre-judged portfolio of up to 16 pages (60 points) and a five-minute presentation (70 points). Built around the MRC program at ASPR, the National Health Security Strategy, disaster risk reduction and youth preparedness, with impact-category matching, form and portfolio checklists, metric calculations, planning timelines and partnership scenarios. All activities must be done with your MRC partner, and every social media post must be approved by the MRC before posting.
